cafe-trip-holiday.name: Cafe Trip on Holiday
cafe-trip-holiday.explanation: Start your holiday exploring beautiful cafes around the city — great atmosphere, aromatic coffee, perfect for relaxing or working.
cafe-trip-holiday.about: A carefully curated cafe trail across Phitsanulok — from minimalist riverside cafes to hidden alley gems and charming vintage shops. Each spot has its own character, perfect for relaxing, photography, or remote work. Enjoy a variety of fresh-brewed coffee, teas, and bakery items.

temple-morning-visit.name: Morning Temple Trail
temple-morning-visit.explanation: Start your morning at Wat Phra Sri Rattana Mahathat — experience its sacred atmosphere and beautiful Thai architecture.
temple-morning-visit.about: A dawn temple trail beginning at Wat Phra Sri Rattana Mahathat, home to the revered Phra Buddha Chinarat — considered the most beautiful Buddha image in Thailand. Continue to the adjacent Wat Nang Phaya. Ideal for experiencing a peaceful morning filled with incense, bells, and the beauty of traditional Thai architecture.

river-dinner.name: River Dinner Experience
river-dinner.explanation: Dine along the Nan River watching the sunset — authentic Thai flavors with a breathtaking view.

sunset-park-walk.name: Sunset Park Walk
sunset-park-walk.explanation: Stroll through Somdej Phra Naresuan Park at golden hour — lush greenery, perfect for unwinding.

evening-bar-hop.name: Evening Bar Hopping
evening-bar-hop.explanation: Explore riverside bars along the Nan River — chill vibes, live music, and beautiful water views.

craft-workshop-day.name: Local Craft Workshop Day
craft-workshop-day.explanation: Learn traditional Phitsanulok handicrafts and make your own souvenir to take home.

heritage-museum-tour.name: Heritage Museum Tour
heritage-museum-tour.explanation: Tour Sergeant Thawee Folk Museum — discover Phitsanulok's rich history and local culture.

night-bazaar-shopping.name: Night Bazaar Shopping
night-bazaar-shopping.explanation: Shop for souvenirs and taste local street food at the lively Nan riverside night market.

Home.hero_sub: Uncover hidden gems, authentic street food, and rich history with our curated local guide.
Home.spots_desc: Discover where the locals go, from historic temples to bustling night markets.
Home.why_title: Experience the Heart of the Lower North
Home.why_body: Phitsanulok blends centuries of history with a thriving modern lifestyle. Walk beside the Nan River, taste legendary boat noodles, and celebrate festivals that have shaped this region for generations.
Home.feat_expertise_desc: Hand-picked spots vetted by residents who know every corner of the city.
Home.feat_food_desc: From boat noodles to hidden rooftop bars — the real Phitsanulok food scene.
Home.feat_events_desc: Stay up-to-date on temple fairs, markets, and community gatherings.
